## CreateHooksResult.invert property

Creates style declarations that invert a provided condition for descendants.

**Signature:**

```typescript
invert: (slot: ContextSlot, condition: Condition<H>) => {
        [P in `--${string}`]: string;
    };
```

## Remarks

The provider and inverter must use the same slot. Each nested inversion reverses the polarity inherited from the previous provider or inverter. Slots may be reused in separate DOM branches, but independent contexts on the same ancestry path must use different slots. Slot ownership is shared by hook systems configured with the same hooks.
